newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 3.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 3.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers quotes rose with cargo levels but sentiment was cautious as traders were sidelined, watching the market closely on further developments on tensions between the United States and Iraq, brokers said. Bunker 180-cst was quoted between $120-$125 and 380-cst at $115-$120 per tonne. MDO rose to $210 from $190-$198 and gas oil to $220 from $205-$206
